verdict.rationale: The Entity Management API uses an explicitly versioned endpoint path (/entity-information/v4/entities), so versioned APIs are evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance; the FPDS ezSearch retirement concerns a UI feature, not API deprecation. missing for 10: documented API deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and migration guidance, versioning evidence across the other SAM.gov APIs, independent corroboration.
